title: WWS TractorLanzBuldogHL12engineinoperation
author: Work With Sounds / Museum of Municipal Engineering
changes: A real vintage Lanz Bulldog HL 12 tractor, whose big single-cylinder engine goes 'putt-putt-putt'. Trimmed to 50.00–52.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Recorded at the National Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa, Poland, for the Work With Sounds project. The 70 Hz high-pass trims measured sub-bass engine rumble.
